chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Lisbon, 2024. Manchester City lead Sporting. Geovany Quenda slides a pass through, and Viktor Gyökeres is off! Strong and fast, he drives on. Right foot... far corner!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. He keeps his body between the defender and the ball. Then he pushes on, past the next defender.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: A hard, low shot across Ederson, and Sporting are level! He scored a hat-trick that night, and Sporting won four-one.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when a defender gets close, use your body to shield the ball, and drive toward goal!
